description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time and timezone information, handles events related to time status and timezone changes, interacts with a JSONRPC system link, and parses timezone transition data. It contains methods for initializing, subscribing to events, updating time status and timezone, and parsing timezone transition information.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: A class that manages system time and timezone synchronization, subscribing to and handling time-related events, and parsing timezone transition data.

methods.name: SystemTime::IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if system time is available, potentially querying a remote system link.

methods.name: SystemTime::GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone accuracy and offset in seconds.

methods.name: SystemTime::onTimeStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when time status changes, updating internal state.

methods.name: SystemTime::onTimeZoneDSTChanged
methods.description: Handles timezone and DST change events, updating internal state.

methods.name: SystemTime::CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the system's RPC interface for time management.

methods.name: SystemTime::SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to time and timezone related events via the JSONRPC link.

methods.name: SystemTime::UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Queries and updates the current system time status.

methods.name: SystemTime::UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Fetches and updates the current timezone information.

methods.name: SystemTime::ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses timezone string and accuracy information to determine offset and accuracy level.

methods.name: SystemTime::PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Reads timezone transition data from zdump output and populates the transition map.

methods.name: SystemTime::EventLoop
methods.description: Main event loop processing time-related events asynchronously.
